name: COHERENT
summary: COHERENT measures neutrino interactions at the pulsed Spallation Neutron Source in Oak Ridge. Its multi-target programme established coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering and tests how the interaction scales with nuclear composition.
physics_targets: Nuclear weak charge and form factors
detection_principle: Pions and muons decaying at rest provide prompt muon neutrinos and delayed electron neutrinos and muon antineutrinos. Timing relative to the proton beam suppresses steady backgrounds. Low-threshold CsI, argon and germanium detectors observe nuclear recoils; other targets study complementary channels.
